visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a mustache, wearing a navy blue blazer and black t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit modern office. He points his finger at the camera while speaking with an expressive facial expression. Background features white office partitions and a desk. (2) The man holds up a long, dark purple eggplant close to his face. He looks at it with an inquisitive expression. Graphic text overlays and cartoon-style lightning icons appear around him. (3) The scene cuts rapidly as the man continues to hold and gesture with the eggplant. Photos of female celebrities and close-ups of eyes/skin are superimposed on the screen to illustrate skin benefits. (4) The man stands behind another male seated at a desk. He uses the eggplant to rhythmically tap the seated man's shoulder and neck area. The background remains the office setting with desks and a yellow couch cushion visible.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice begins speaking loudly over a rhythmic, synth-based BGM with a moderate tempo. A sharp percussive 'whoosh' sound effect accentuates the start. (2) A brief dialogue exchange occurs where a secondary male voice interjects with a questioning tone, followed by the main speaker responding with high vocal arousal. (3) The main speaker explains skin benefits with a fast speech rate and clear articulation. Stylized 'ding' and 'pop' comedy sound effects are mixed in to punctuate visual transitions. (4) Background laughter tracks from a crowd are heard softly as the man makes humorous comments. A final percussive thud sound effect marks the moment the eggplant is used to tap another person.
